notes: Default slow variables are r_rms, density_rms, anisotropy.
Each robust-z slow variable is split into four pooled quantile bins.
Transitions are counted at lag 0.10 s within each observation.
Nontrivial right eigenvectors are cut at the stationary-mass weighted median.
Frame ulam_cell values are mapped to low/high labels.
3032b labels are read by observation and time.
compact_density_2 is copied from spectral_set when available.
Events are label switches with both adjacent runs at least 0.20 s.
